data.one_liner: Expandable widget with customizable title, content, and animation
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple widget that expands and collapses with animation. It allows custom content, title, and optional scrolling.
use_when: Need a quick expandable section in a UI
Want minimal code for expandable content
Require basic animation and scrolling support
avoid_when: Complex nested expansions requiring custom animation curves
Need advanced state management or integration with other packages
strengths: Easy to use with minimal boilerplate
Highly customizable title, content, and dimensions
Supports scrolling inside the expanded area
weaknesses: No advanced animation control or theming options
